description: Source code for MediaTrack class and related functionalities in Android's stagefright media framework, including ReadOptions and MediaTrackCUnwrapper implementations.

classes.name: MediaTrack
classes.description: Represents a media track with options for reading and seeking.

classes.name: MediaTrack::ReadOptions
classes.description: Options for reading media data, including non-blocking and seek modes.

classes.name: MediaTrackCUnwrapper
classes.description: Wrapper class to interface with C media track objects, providing start, stop, getFormat, and read functionalities.

methods.name: MediaTrack::ReadOptions::setNonBlocking
methods.description: Sets the read operation to non-blocking mode.

methods.name: MediaTrack::ReadOptions::clearNonBlocking
methods.description: Clears the non-blocking mode for read operations.

methods.name: MediaTrack::ReadOptions::getNonBlocking
methods.description: Returns whether non-blocking mode is set.

methods.name: MediaTrack::ReadOptions::setSeekTo
methods.description: Sets the seek position and mode for reading.

methods.name: MediaTrack::ReadOptions::getSeekTo
methods.description: Retrieves the seek position and mode.

methods.name: MediaTrackCUnwrapper::read
methods.description: Reads media data into buffer with options.

methods.name: MediaTrackCUnwrapper::supportNonblockingRead
methods.description: Checks if non-blocking read is supported.
